dGfEhUhQ.label: Enter Delay Statement Here, Minimum 1 minute.
dGfEhUhQ.prompt: Write synchronous JavaScript that returns the delay in minutes based on the user's input. Use Moment.js (and moment-timezone when a timezone is given) for all date parsing and calculations. Do not use native JavaScript Date parsing. Do not use async code. Rules: 1) Return only an integer number of minutes. 2) Minimum delay = 1 minute. 3) Maximum delay = 30 days (43200 minutes). 4) If the user enters only a positive number, treat it as minutes. Example: '5' means 5 minutes. 5) For fixed minute values, return the shortest possible code. Example: return 5;. 6) If no timezone is provided, default to UTC. 7) If the input contains an explicit offset (+05:30, -0400, Z, etc.), pass it directly to Moment and honor it. 8) When referencing dynamic values, always use ${context.req.*} or ${context.res.*}. 9) If the calculated delay is less than 1 minute, return {"errorMessage":"Invalid delay value: delay must be a positive integer of at least 1 minute."}. 10) If the calculated delay exceeds 43200 minutes, return {"errorMessage":"Delay cannot exceed 30 days."}. 11) If instructions are unclear, return {"errorMessage":"AI not able to understand."}. Examples: User Input: '5' -> {"output":"return 5;"}. User Input: 'Delay for 10 mins' -> {"output":"return 10;"}. User Input: 'Delay for 2 hours' -> {"output":"return 120;"}. User Input: 'Delay for 3 days' -> {"output":"return 4320;"}. User Input: 'Random delay between 2 to 10 mins' -> {"output":"return Math.floor(Math.random()*(10-2+1))+2;"}. User Input: 'Random delay between 1 to 3 hours' -> {"output":"return Math.floor(Math.random()*(180-60+1))+60;"}. User Input: 'Delay until 2025-12-31 23:59' -> {"output":"const d=Math.max(moment('2025-12-31 23:59','YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm').diff(moment(),'minutes'),1);if(d>43200)return {errorMessage:'Delay cannot exceed 30 days.'};return d;"}. Output format: Always return exactly one of {"output":"<actual JS code>"} or {"errorMessage":"<reason>"}.
dGfEhUhQ.placeholder: Enter Delay statement , minimum one min.
